Name: Linus Narrative Overhaul
Author: haywrites
Description:
[color=#ff7700][size=4][i][size=5]Welcome to the Linus Narrative Overhaul! 2.0 out now![/size][/i][/size][/color]
[size=4]
You asked, you voted, and now here is the Linus Narrative Overhaul!

Linus is truly one with nature, and full of wisdom to impart on those who wish to know it.

In this Narrative Overhaul, I've designed Linus to have an engaging relationship, if you're willing to put in the time.

With dialogues for every day of every season and every heart level, you'll have a reason to talk to Linus!

[font=Verdana][size=4]1.3 And Beyond
With 1.3, the way .xnb files are found has been changed! In order to use my mods, you must
use the versatile and friendly Content Patcher.

How to install Content Patcher and the Mods:
[list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Download Content Patcher[/url]﻿

[*]Unzip the contents of Content Patcher into Stardew Valley/Mods.
[*]Install any content packs (Narrative Overhauls) you want by unzipping them into Stardew Valley/Mods.
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]
A bit more complicated versus what it was before, but at least it will be possible!
For the Content Patcher version of this mod, download the 1.3 Multiplayer Patch Version of this mod!

(The latest versions of the mod files, uploaded 6/6/18, are the official versions, with the most up to date patches.)

PRE 1.3:
(THE BELOW WILL NOT WORK IF YOU HAVE THE MOST UP TO DATE VERSION OF STARDEW
VALLEY. See the "1.3 and Beyond" section above if you have the most
recent patch (1.3 Multiplayer)[/size][/font]
[color=#ffd966]
How to install:
Incredibly simple:[/color]
1. Download and Unzip the XNB file.
2. Go to where you installed Stardew Valley.
3. Go to [color=#ffd966]Stardew Valley\Content\Characters\Dialogue[/color]
4. Move the XNB file over and overwrite the old one.
5. You're done!

[i]This mod is Rated E, and uses no gender pronouns for your player character.[/i]

[/size]
[size=5][url=https://twitter.com/Haywritesalot]Follow me on Twitter! It helps, and you can see when new updates come out. Click here![/url][/size]

[color=#ffffff]If you played this mod and liked it, or didn't like it, please let me know here on Nexus Mod or at my personal e-mail at haywrites@gmail.com
[url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/43516662/?tb=mods&pUp=1][size=5]
Check out my other Narrative Overhaul mods by clicking here![/size]
[/url]
[/color][/size][/color][size=6]Thank you for playing!
[size=2]Check out haywrites.wordpress.com for more of my recent work!
[/size][/size]
